free_tier.stated: Each project in a Free tier namespace on GitLab.com has 10 GiB of free storage.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: The default limit is 52428800 bytes (50 MB).
per_object_cap.notes: The snippets page gives 50 MB as the default maximum snippet size and as current as of 2024-04-17.

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: Dormant project deletion is disabled on GitLab.com. No expiry period is stated on the pages read.

egress.terms: unverified: no egress charge or volume quota is stated on the pages read.

tooling: glab CLI (glab snippet create), VS Code extension, REST /api/v4/snippets, plain git clone/push for project repos.
chaining: Personal snippets are independent of any project, and the default maximum size for a snippet is 50 MB. Versioned snippets are considered part of the namespace storage size, so they are not a separate storage pool.
limits_note: When a project's repository and LFS exceed the 10 GiB free storage, the project is set to a read-only state and you cannot push changes until storage is purchased. Storage usage is updated every 90 minutes.

identity_cost.detail: no identity_cost field and no identity statement in the source record; defaulted to email and flagged, not evidence

reliability_note: Read-only lockout is automatic and immediate on exceeding 10 GiB, and it blocks pushes rather than deletes data. Snippets are counted in namespace storage, so they are not a separate free pool.
confidence_note: the administration snippets page states the default snippet size limit is 52428800 bytes (50 MB)

extras.verified_at_basis: checked against the live service on 2026-11-10
extras.quota_verbatim: 10 GiB free storage per project on GitLab.com Free tier (repo + LFS); snippet files up to 50 MB each (50,000,000-byte default admin limit); projects per account and accounts are free.
extras.limits_verbatim: 10 GiB per project then the project goes read-only (pushes rejected) until storage is purchased — a hard stop, not a warning; 50 MB per snippet; namespace storage updated every 90 minutes; 5 GiB per-file push limit on gitlab.com is not documented publicly, so shard files.
extras.egress_verbatim: unmetered, served from gitlab.com; no egress line item exists on any GitLab.com plan.
extras.chaining_verbatim: 10 GiB free per project x unlimited projects per free account x unlimited free accounts. Snippets add a parallel 50 MB-per-object path that does not require a project. 10 TiB hot = ~1000 projects at 10 GiB, spread over accounts.
extras.tooling_verbatim: glab CLI (glab snippet create), VS Code extension, REST /api/v4/snippets, plain git clone/push for project repos. rclone has a 'gitlab' backend (yes — rclone supports GitLab as a Git remote type via backend 'git').
extras.agent_focus: pastebins and text dumps as storage: pastebin, hastebin, ghostbin, rentry, dpaste, privatebin, GitHub Gist, GitLab snippets, pastes.io, controlc, termbin, plus binary-to-text encoders
